# MS21250 — 12-Point Tension Bolts
# Reference site by TorqBolt (Mumbai / Rajkot, India)
# Sitemap: https://ms21250.com/sitemap.xml

MS21250 is the United States Military Standard for a flanged, 12-point (double-hex) external wrenching tension bolt, titled "Bolt, Tension, Steel, External Wrenching, Flanged, 12-Point." It is made from alloy steel per the governing specification, cadmium plated, with a minimum ultimate tensile strength of 180,000 psi (180 ksi) and a 450 deg F service rating. The standard has been redesignated NASM21250 with the requirements retained, and the bolt is procured against MIL-B-8831B (1982).

## Part-number form
MS21250[H]-DD-LLL
- H (optional): drilled head for safety wire
- DD: diameter dash code (diameter in 1/16-inch units; 03 = 3/16", 04 = 1/4", 05 = 5/16", 06 = 3/8", 07 = 7/16", 08 = 1/2", 09 = 9/16", 10 = 5/8", 12 = 3/4", 14 = 7/8")
- LLL: grip length in 1/16-inch increments (012 = 0.750")
Example: MS21250-05012 = 5/16" diameter, 0.750" grip, undrilled head.

## Related designations
- NASM21250 — current designation (redesignation of MS21250)
- MIL-B-8831B — procurement specification behind the standard
